fields.name: Warps
fields.value:
Warps are teleporting points, such as homes, but everyone can use and edit them. Their coordinates are posted in <#942007917589200918>.
**~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~**
Les *warps* sont comme les *homes* mais tout le monde peut les utiliser et les modifier. Leurs coordonnées sont postées dans <#942007917589200918>.

• setting a warp: `/setwarp <warp name>`
• teleporting to a warp: `/warp <warp name>`
• deleting a warp: `/delwarp <warp name>`
• moving a warp: `/movewarp <warp name>`
• listing all of the warps: `/warps`
